metadata.title: Dose records, analysis code and figures for: Per-powder Bayesian calibration of an auger doser for alloy feedstock preparation, and dosing records as a probe of powder flow
metadata.description: Every calibration and production dose record of an open-source, 3D-printed auger powder doser from 29 September to 20 October 2026 (125 records with balance telemetry): two multi-objective Bayesian-optimization campaigns on sodium chloride and their validation blocks, single doses from 5 mg to 10 g at the recommended settings, and doses of gas-atomized AlSi10Mg and laboratory-atomized Al 4047 into atomizer charges. Also included are the campaign configurations, the scripts that compute every statistic and figure in the manuscript, the supplementary tables, and the manuscript source.
